A dense understory of tree ferns and cycads under tall Cheirolepid conifers whose canopy nearly closes above, grey-green bark on every trunk running with resin pooling and running down the low side in thick amber runnels that gather at the root collars, a ginkgo at the edge its lime-green fan-leaves catching the filtered light, seen from the litter looking up the slope

A grove of thick-buttressed kauri forms in close rank, every upper surface of bark and horizontal root dusted grey with volcanic ash lying undisturbed in the needle-shade, a broad amber flow pouring over one great root buttress in a slow continuous amber waterfall pooling on the ash-grey litter below, silver lichen spreading across the north-facing bark above the flow, seen from midway along at trunk height

A swamp margin where thick-buttressed kauri stand in black still water on flared root-flanges, each trunk pale grey and monumental, one whole flank worn smooth into a single continuous glaze of amber running in an unbroken sheet from mid-trunk to the waterline, bare grey mud showing in every open patch between the root-flanges, seen from inside the hollow looking out

A field of old Agathis-like kauri giant stumps each one crowned with a young sapling heir, the parent flanks broad and pale-grey running with thick amber sheets still wet and bright at the leading edge, young trunks rising straight from the wreckage in silver-green columns, blue-grey depth opening between the further trunks, seen along the colonnade from between two trunks

A close ring of Agathis-like kauri trunks above a floor buried in fallen cones, their silver-grey girths massive and running with resin from two stumps that has crept across the litter and pooled in a broad slow lake of clouded amber on the ground, cone-littered needle-litter pressing to the pool edge, seen from upslope looking down the leaning ranks into the pooled light

A stand of Araucaria monkey-puzzles at the lip of a cliff, last roots knotted and gripping the crumbling edge, rust-red bark plated in rough scales, a young sapling rising straight from a resin-cemented crack splitting one trunk, amber cement holding the gap firm and glazed, deep rust needle-litter thickening around the root bases, seen low across the nodule floor

A fallen tall conifer trunk bridging a gully, its upper surface crowded with young Araucaria saplings rooting into the softened bark, an old amber flow hardened into a broad ledge running the full length of the trunk a metre off the ground, pale gold and glass-smooth at its lip, emerald moss cushions packed along the exposed roots below, seen from outside looking through the hanging strands

A nursery of scaly-barked podocarp saplings crowding the floor beneath one broad parent trunk, its bark pale silver-grey and running with a fresh amber sheet, moisture beading across the wet surface in dense silver drops sitting proud of the flow, horsetails massed at the base of each small trunk catching the lateral amber light, seen from the edge of the root crater looking across
